intro: Tanzania's economy relies on farming, gold, tourism and gas.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Gold is the top export. Safari and beach tourism are big, and cashews, coffee, tea and cloves are grown. Tanzanite, a blue gem, is found only near Kilimanjaro.

chapters.title: Ports
text: Dar es Salaam's port serves landlocked neighbours like Zambia, Rwanda and Uganda.

keyTerms.meaning: A blue gem found only in Tanzania.

cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Tanzania makes and sells to the world.
